title: Snowmen at Night
author: Caralyn Buehner

hero.name: Snowman
hero.description: Classic round snowman with carrot nose, coal eyes, scarf and top hat — the main character of the book
hero.source_note: Generic snowman is well represented in Boardmaker symbol libraries

ambiguous.issue: Could mean temperature sensation (adjective) or illness (noun)
ambiguous.reason: Book is about snowmen outside in winter — cold refers to the weather/temperature

ambiguous.issue: Could be confused with general liquid concepts
ambiguous.reason: Central to the story — snowmen melt, so pairing with snowman image clarifies meaning

notes: Snowmen at Night imagines what snowmen do when no one is watching — they play, eat carrots, have snowball fights, and stay up under the moon and stars. The fringe prioritises the key sensory and story elements a student can comment on: the snowy setting, the snowman accessories (carrot nose, hat, scarf), key actions (snowball, melt, sleep), and the nighttime sky (moon, stars). The hero snowman is generic enough for standard Boardmaker. Consider adding action words like 'play' or 'eat' from core if the student is ready to combine. 'cold' should be represented by a thermometer or shivering figure, not a sick face.
